description: Barragens- RH Paraguai is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Conjunto de barragens na bacia - RH Paraguai [CPAP]. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are CPAP, Mato Grosso, Mato Grosso do Sul, RH-Paraguai, Brazil. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
